title: Gemini CLI suddenly signed out and OAuth now reports a licensed organization account as unauthorized

triage_metadata.reasoning: The reported issue describes an OAuth authorization error ('Sign-in failed: The following products are not yet authorized to access your account') displayed on Google's browser authentication page. This error indicates an issue with Google Cloud organization OAuth policies, API access controls, or account entitlement/licensing propagation rather than a systemic code defect in the Gemini CLI codebase. Under the quality evaluation guidelines, setup and configuration failures occurring outside the repository's source code require additional diagnostic and organizational details to determine if any CLI action is possible.
triage_metadata.comment: Hi! Thanks for commenting on this issue, we need more information to triage the bug. The error reported occurs on Google's OAuth sign-in screen, which indicates an organization-level OAuth app policy, Google Workspace API restriction, or backend entitlement validation issue rather than a defect in the Gemini CLI codebase. Could you please clarify if this account experiences the same failure when authenticating through other Gemini developer tools (such as the Cloud Code extension), whether any OAuth App Control or Context-Aware Access policies were recently updated in your Google Cloud or Workspace admin console, and whether authenticating via Application Default Credentials (`gcloud auth application-default login`) works in your environment?
